theme_and_archetype.description: Organic & Earthy mixed with Jewel & Luxury. Premium 'Parchment + Imperial Gold' theme. Warm, sophisticated, authoritative, India-first Dalal Street veteran feel.

screen_layouts.dashboard: Parchment background. Top header with TT Logo. Portfolio card at the top. 'What If' horizontally scrollable or static card. List of holdings with Watchlist toggle.
screen_layouts.trade_detail: Price displayed in large DMMono. Line chart for 1D/1W/1M/1Y. Fixed bottom tab for Buy/Sell taking full width with gap.
screen_layouts.analytics: Ring chart or bar charts for sector allocation. Grid layout (using row/col Flexbox) for XIRR, Win Rate stats.
screen_layouts.compete_leagues: Weekly timer prominently displayed. Top 3 users highlighted in elevated UI. FlatList of users ranked 4th onwards.
screen_layouts.wallet: Balance in massive PlayfairDisplay. Two large primary CTA buttons (+ Add Cash, withdraw). Transaction history FlatList below.

micro_interactions.button_press: Use TouchableOpacity (activeOpacity={0.8}) for subtle dimming on all interactive elements.
micro_interactions.list_scroll: Use FlatList with standard smooth scrolling and showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}.
micro_interactions.modal_open: Use React Native Modal with slide animation for Buy/Sell.

testing.data_testid_rule: Apply testID='kebab-case-name' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, list items) to comply with data-testid testing requirements in Expo.

gold_crown_logo.description: Luxury 3D Imperial Gold crown icon for app logo, splash screen, and header.

bombay_stock_exchange_vintage.description: Vintage or historic financial building stock image, can be used for onboarding or background elements to emphasize Dalal street veteran vibes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Parchment (#F5F2EC) background color for all main app screens instead of default white.
Use testID property (instead of web's data-testid) for all interactive components since this is React Native.
Ensure 'expo-font' is used to asynchronously load PlayfairDisplay, DMSans, and DMMono before rendering the main UI.
StyleSheet objects must strictly use numeric values for spacing, fontSize, borderRadius, rather than strings with 'px'.
All financial data arrays/lists must use DMMono for numerical displays (prices, percentages) for clean tabular alignment.
